metadata.notes: Max bids represent the absolute ceiling. Never exceed these amounts. Bids include the catch fee — e.g., if catch fee is $59 and max_bid is $150, you can bid up to $150 total in auction. The catch fee is the floor, not added on top.

bidding_rules: NEVER exceed the absolute_max for any domain — no exceptions
Start bidding at ideal_price tier and only escalate if outbid
Use proxy bidding where available (NameJet, GoDaddy) — set to absolute_max and let the system bid minimally
If two domains are in simultaneous auctions, prioritize by DA * RD score
Track total committed spend across all platforms to avoid exceeding $565 budget
If you win jerusalemonline.com at $300, reduce ghostautonomy.com max to $200
If you win ghostautonomy.com at $400, skip all remaining auctions above $75
Reserve at least $100 for unexpected opportunities
